title: The Expanded Nike Mind Platform Gives Athletes More Choice in Sensation
summary: Nike is introducing four new Nike Mind footwear models: the Nike Mind Sock, Nike Mind Moc Flyknit, Nike Mind Slip and Nike Mind Sneaker. Together with the Nike Mind 001, the new styles give athletes a range of choice in both sensation and style.
body_markdown:
Nike Mind pushes the edge of sport, activating athletes’ senses to support their pre-game routines.


Now, Nike is expanding Nike Mind beyond a single footwear style into a broader platform, exploring how sensory-based concepts can support athletes across an expanded suite of science-backed innovations.


Athletes are increasingly focused on mental preparation. By studying perception, neuroscience and cognition, the Nike Mind Science team within the[Nike Sport Research Lab](https://about.nike.com/en/magazine/lebron-james-innovation-center-nike-sport-research-lab) aims to understand more about how the brain and body work together. This will allow Nike to design new categories of Nike Mind innovations that move with athletes through every phase of their journey, from preparation to performance and recovery.


“Footwear is just the beginning for Nike Mind,” says Phil McCartney, EVP, Chief Innovation, Design & Product Officer. “We’re building on what we’ve learned to bring more sensory experiences, more choice and new ways to support athletes across footwear and apparel — helping them through every phase of their journey in sport."


Since launching the Nike Mind 001, Nike has learned that athletes want a range of ways to activate their senses. Some look for a more intense underfoot sensation, while others want a softer sensation they can wear all day. That insight led to the introduction of four new Nike Mind footwear models: the Nike Mind Sock, Nike Mind Moc Flyknit, Nike Mind Slip and Nike Mind Sneaker.


Each Nike Mind footwear style is designed to activate an athlete’s senses by amplifying underfoot sensation, creating a dynamic foot-to-ground connection that provides a unique sensory experience with every step.


While keeping the iconic 22 foam nodes across all Nike Mind footwear styles, Nike is introducing a new, secondary underfoot construction that allows for a range of sensation.


The **Nike Mind Slip** , **Nike Mind Moc Flyknit** and **Nike Mind Sneaker** are designed for all-day wear, featuring the new underfoot construction method that bridges the 22 nodes together, offering a softer underfoot sensation.


Meanwhile, the **Nike Mind Sock** joins the Nike Mind 001 as innovations designed for game-day prep, offering athletes a more intense underfoot sensation, featuring the original construction of 22 individual moving nodes.


This expansion of Nike Mind footwear gives athletes a range of choice in both sensation and style, meeting their needs during their training journey.


The Nike Mind 001 is available now at[nike.com](https://www.nike.com/t/mind-001-mens-pregame-mules-6CoTxAk6) and select retail locations. The Nike Mind Sock, Nike Mind Moc Flyknit, Nike Mind Slip and Nike Mind Sneaker will be available beginning in summer 2027. More details to follow.


***NIKE, Inc. is providing a sneak peek of the expanded Nike Mind platform as part of its World of Athletes* event, which offers an exclusive first look into some of the footwear and apparel that will debut in seasons to come. View the showcase***[here](https://about.nike.com/en/topics/inside-nike-strategy) ***.***
